description: Syslog Router routing rules for Cisco ASA/FTD/IOS events. Installed as logs-syslog_router.log@custom so the syslog_router integration ingest pipeline reroutes matched events to the correct integration data stream.

set.description:
Equivalent Elastic Agent reroute_config:
- if:
    and:
      - not.has_fields: _conf.dataset
      - regexp.message: "%ASA-"
  then:
    - add_fields:
        target: ''
        fields:
          _conf.dataset: cisco_asa.log
          _conf.tz_offset: UTC
          _temp_.internal_zones: ['trust']
          _temp_.external_zones: ['untrust']

Equivalent Elastic Agent reroute_config:
- if:
    and:
      - not.has_fields: _conf.dataset
      - regexp.message: "%FTD-"
  then:
    - add_fields:
        target: ''
        fields:
          _conf.dataset: cisco_ftd.log
          _conf.tz_offset: UTC
          _temp_.internal_zones: ['trust']
          _temp_.external_zones: ['untrust']

Equivalent Elastic Agent reroute_config:
- if:
    and:
      - not.has_fields: _conf.dataset
      - regexp.message: "%\\S+-\\d-\\S+\\s?:"
  then:
    - add_fields:
        target: ''
        fields:
          _conf.dataset: cisco_ios.log
          _conf.tz_offset: UTC
Sets _conf.tz_offset to UTC for events whose upstream reroute_config would have set it: cisco_asa, cisco_ftd and cisco_ios.
Sets _temp_.internal_zones for events whose upstream reroute_config includes it: cisco_asa and cisco_ftd.
Sets _temp_.external_zones for events whose upstream reroute_config includes it: cisco_asa and cisco_ftd.
